supersedes: protocol_v1.json (archived per-update promotion protocol; never executed as a formal experiment)
track: Controlled shared-evidence ResearchRubrics task evaluation; custom split, not an unrestricted official leaderboard submission

update_policy.proposal_selection: First structurally and evidence-reference-valid reconciled proposal, in original returned order; at most one write per source task

evolution.order_seed_semantics: Task ordering only; current serving API does not guarantee model sampling seed control
evolution.initial_state: Empty three-bank experience store and a fixed public JIT reference archive; no imported pilot experience
evolution.position_unit: Prespecified source-task slots consumed, including execution failure, incomplete evaluation, no proposal, or failed structural checks; not successful writes or SQLite version
evolution.failed_source_slot: Record failure and cost, do not replace or regenerate the task, leave state unchanged if no commit occurred, advance position once. Crash recovery resolves the original journal/atomic commit before advancing.
evolution.continue_from: Latest trajectory state, never the validation winner

validation.purpose: Select one whole frozen checkpoint per independent run for final deployment evaluation; never accept/reject individual updates
validation.task_scope: The same entire fixed 20-task validation set at every checkpoint
validation.candidate_scope: All seven checkpoints of this run, including C0; not only the latest batch or latest winners
validation.store_access: Independent read-only connection, explicit historical snapshot version and content hash
validation.checkpoint_identity: All three experience banks and policy versions plus fixed code/prompt/model/tool/reference-archive/selector hashes; position is separate from store version
validation.state_deduplication: Within a method/run, identical complete checkpoint state and execution identity reuses the original task/repeat artifacts and scores; never resample an unchanged checkpoint for another chance
validation.historical_score_reuse: Cache already evaluated checkpoints; each later validation event evaluates only the new distinct checkpoint on all20 tasks, then compares against all cached candidates
validation.selection_utility: U(C)=sum over20 tasks and2 repeats of q_or_lower_bound(C,t,r)/40; q is the complete pinned official task score, missing task evaluations use L_t=sum(negative weights)/sum(positive weights). This is a conservative selection surrogate, not an observed official score.
validation.eligibility: At least36 of40 complete official task evaluations. Below this is an infrastructure/completion-ineligible checkpoint, not a rejected experience update; retain it in all logs.
validation.winner: After all 30 source slots compute U_max over eligible candidates; the tie set is every candidate with U >= U_max - 1e-12. Within this set prefer more complete evaluations, then earliest source position, then lexical state hash. Do not use non-transitive pairwise tolerance comparisons.
validation.no_eligible_candidate: Run is inconclusive; do not substitute a favorable run, add checkpoints, or use TEST to choose
validation.selection_frequency: Log provisional argmax at each scheduled checkpoint; seal the final winner only after C30
validation.feedback_visibility: Only fixed selector gets scores/completion flags; no validation answers, rubrics, traces or scores reach evolution agents or human implementation tuning

test.task_scope: All33 fixed test tasks; no quality-based task removal
test.evolved_states: Each of the3 run-specific validation winners; never just the highest-scoring run
test.terminal_state_control: Also evaluate each run's C30 as a preregistered secondary analysis
test.static_control_reuse: C0 and each static baseline are evaluated3 times/task in total, shared across the3 evolved-run comparisons; not rerun9 times or treated as9 independent outputs
test.duplicate_state_reuse: Predeclared exact identity match reuses saved artifacts when selected==terminal or selected==C0; persist explicit reused_from references and count only actual requests
test.release_feedback: Only after all mandatory methods, variants and G/GO submissions are committed and all run-specific selections and source/config identities are sealed; then evaluate/release the common test set
test.test_result_policy: All3 artifact replicates are scored and averaged, never best-of3; a missing result stays missing
test.primary_estimand: Task mean of [mean over3 evolved runs and3 repeats of selected-state score] minus [mean over3 repeats of shared C0 score]
test.interpretation: Within-benchmark task generalization on a custom33-task subset; no SOTA or full-benchmark claim

methods.implementation: Required; existing fixed_team_jit pilot is not this rubric-guided fixed-harness baseline

methods.role: Dynamic MAS with ordinary task planning but no explicit rubric graph/bank; organization/execution experience can evolve
methods.implementation: Config exists; full matched-evolution/parity audit required

methods.role: Disable local planning, retain dynamic global planning and global-local attribution
methods.implementation: Config exists; matched construction opportunity audit required

methods.implementation: Toggle exists; equal-evidence interface/parity still required

mechanism_diagnostic.states: Full method's3 preselected snapshots, no further evolution or checkpoint selection
conditions: G: constructor and JIT generator cannot see shared R_star; inject it into actor inputs only after structural freeze
GO: constructor and generator see R_star; actors receive exactly the same guidance as G
mechanism_diagnostic.shared_rubrics: Generate one quality-only R_star per state/task/repeat from public task, evidence and permitted frozen experience before team formation; no assignments or hidden criteria; reuse identical hash in both conditions
mechanism_diagnostic.construction_policy: Same construction call/token ceilings; no role/dependency/harness rewrite after the controlled freeze boundary
mechanism_diagnostic.implementation: Post-compile guidance injection and constructor non-exposure audit required; not implemented by ordinary explicit_rubrics toggle

optional_extensions.schedule: Same30 source slots,7 full-val checkpoints,3 order runs,selected TEST3 repeats;1227 nominal task slots
optional_extensions.requirement: Pinned author implementation or explicitly identified adaptation; no substitution by a fixed team

optional_extensions.schedule: Same30 source slots,7 full-val checkpoints,3 order runs,selected TEST3 repeats;1227 nominal task slots
optional_extensions.requirement: Pinned author implementation or explicitly identified adaptation; report any irreducible update/budget differences

optional_extensions.status: Not part of this locked primary protocol; requires separate dataset/adapter/retrieval preregistration before any primary test feedback is revealed, otherwise exploratory only

workload.unit: Nominal complete-task artifact slots, NOT API requests; exact-state reuse may reduce actual runs
workload.excluded_from_total: Shared evidence preparation, shared R_star construction, security review, judge transport retries and human audit; these must still be accounted separately

models_and_resources.serving_identity: Freeze endpoint/model revision and returned metadata before launch. Proxy identifiers are not independently verified model identities. Endpoint/model changes invalidate matched comparisons.
models_and_resources.local_attribution: One independent local analysis per role, at most one bounded evidence exchange; unchanged across checkpoints
models_and_resources.unmodified_jit_control: Its native runtime may allocate calls differently under the same total inference ceiling; do not force MAS single-pass behavior into the JIT control and call it unmodified
models_and_resources.cost_policy: Report common ceilings AND measured inference, attribution/update, checkpoint selection, evidence preparation and test judging costs. Actual computation need not be equal. Shared static controls are charged once; report raw and reuse-adjusted totals. Unknown money remains null.

evidence.primary_policy: One common public-only evidence pack per task, frozen before any formal evolution/validation/test generation; no model may browse outside its current task pack in the primary controlled track
evidence.retriever: Same frozen execution model, one query-planning call (max4096 output tokens, temperature0), at most4 public-task-derived queries; no rubric/answer/score access
evidence.search: Pinned provider/config, top5 results/query; record request, time, raw response, result order and hashes
evidence.documents: Process query order then rank, deduplicate canonical URLs, fetch at most8 unique pages plus explicit public task attachments; record every failure, no replacement chosen after scores
evidence.packing: Deterministic source order and text extraction, total32768 tokens under tiktoken cl100k_base with package/encoding hash pinned, round-robin truncation across sources with URL/date/locator preservation; no outcome-dependent summarization. This is a common pack-size measure, not a claim about the proxy model's native tokenizer or billed usage.
evidence.time_policy: Respect explicit task cutoff; record retrieval timestamp, reject known post-cutoff sources, retain missing/unverifiable source notices. Public source/topic audit precedes freeze.
evidence.access: Task-local immutable mount; evaluator rubrics/reference answers and other tasks' packs not mounted in generated-code environment
evidence.cost: Prepare once, share identically across all methods/checkpoints/repeats, report actual preprocessing separately and deployment-equivalent per-task preprocessing cost
evidence.implementation: Retriever/cache, bounded source-pack loader and sandbox boundary not yet implemented/audited; primary run blocked until ready

failures.judge_retry: One retry after30 seconds using the exact frozen artifact, criterion and judge request; valid returned judgments are never rerun to improve a score. Log both attempts. Schema-invalid judgments stay missing.
failures.partial_evaluation: Never renormalize over available criteria; official_score=null when incomplete. Preserve raw partial output separately.
failures.selection_missing_value: Task-specific official feasible lower bound, flagged is_imputed_for_selection=true; never overwrite observed-score field
failures.zero_positive_denominator: Pinned evaluator behavior (flagged deterministic zero) is preserved; interval[0,0], no task deletion
failures.test_missingness: Report completion and failures plus task/method mean feasible intervals and paired-difference bounds. No complete-case-only headline, no superiority claim without a complete prespecified official comparison.
failures.outage_or_code_defect: Suspend launch/continuation without consuming new task attempts; retain started failures. Any source/config change requires a new preregistered run version, never silent replacement of failed/low-scoring runs. After test exposure, new tuning is exploratory.

analysis.unit: Whole test task,33 units; not individual rubrics, requests, repeat artifacts or3x33 independent tasks

bootstrap.pairing: Resample task IDs retaining all method scores, evolved-run labels and artifact repeats; static control remains shared

analysis.run_variation: Report each of the3 trajectories, selected positions and test effects plus mean/min/max; task bootstrap is conditional on these states and does not eliminate between-run uncertainty
analysis.primary_test: Selected minus C0, two-sided paired task sign-flip test,100000 draws,seed20261001,p=(1+extreme)/(100001)
analysis.secondary_family: Selected minus matched JIT and selected minus rubric-guided fixed; Holm correction over these2 p-values, both descriptive unless primary effect also supports improvement
analysis.mechanisms: Predeclared no-rubric/global-only-planning/global-only-attribution/G-vs-GO contrasts; Holm over4 mechanism tests; report every contrast and interval, not only positive effects
analysis.evolution_curves: VAL selection utility, complete official-score fraction and observed-score denominator at all7 source positions; no test sweep across all checkpoints
analysis.diagnostics: Trace used experience IDs through changed requirements/organization/artifacts; retrieval alone does not establish transfer or causal attribution
analysis.power_limit: 33 test tasks supports bounded within-benchmark evidence; repeated API calls do not increase independent task N. No minimum detectable effect is claimed without a justified variance estimate.

human_audit.task_ids: The10 public-ID-ranked test tasks listed in splits_v2.json:human_audit
human_audit.artifacts: ours_selected run0 repeat0, ours_initial repeat0, jit_matched repeat0;30 artifacts, not selected by scores
human_audit.blinding: Randomized anonymous artifact labels, no method/checkpoint/model-score labels, pinned official rubrics after all submissions are sealed
human_audit.procedure: Independent criterion satisfaction/evidence-grounding annotation; report agreement and disagreements, third-rater adjudication only for disagreements; no feedback into training/selection

required_before_launch: Public duplicate/source/time-cutoff audit on the inherited split; no score-based resampling. Any actual leakage requires a versioned amendment before any formal API run.
Explicit checkpoint scheduler, full-val selector, read-only historical state runner and per-slot resume/failure journals with tests; no relabeling VAL as TEST.
Shared evidence retrieval/cache/loader and generated-code containment excluding private rubrics, other-task data and credentials.
Pinned model/provider identities, code/prompts/config/source/evidence/launcher/selector hashes and sandbox settings.
All mandatory baselines and G/GO information-flow controls implemented and debugged only on quarantined development tasks.
Test submission sealing and feedback-release guard; all mandatory choices frozen before test feedback.
Fresh artifact directories/stores and explicit request to launch the preregistered experiment; this plan is not automatic launch authorization.
